rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"TypeCollector now sends every analyzer diagnostic through a filter, ReportIfLocatedInCompilation. The filter drops any diagnostic whose location is not in a syntax tree of the current compilation. Two places that read DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] now read it in a null-safe way: the property BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull location, through a new helper GetPropertyIdentifierLocation, and the field MemberNeedsKey location. Those reads used to throw for members that come from metadata. New generator tests compile a defining assembly to an image, reference it as metadata only, and check that there are no diagnostics and that a resolver is generated. The docs now explain where diagnostics for types from referenced assemblies are reported.","why":"Issue 2283: a [MessagePackObject] type with a member whose type is a closed generic struct or record struct from a referenced assembly crashed the generator and analyzer with IndexOutOfRangeException.
